content.short: SingularityNET is a decentralized AI marketplace on Cardano enabling the creation and sharing of AI.
content.description: SingularityNET is a pioneering decentralized marketplace designed to democratize access to artificial intelligence services on the Cardano blockchain. The platform allows anyone to create, share, and monetize AI technologies at scale through its globally distributed network. By providing a secure and transparent framework for AI-to-AI collaboration, SingularityNET is building the foundation for a decentralized artificial general intelligence (AGI). Users and developers can interact with a wide variety of AI agents, fostering a collaborative ecosystem that prioritizes innovation and ethics.
